    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(FULLDATE),
    HEAP
) AS

/*=========PATCH_SCRIPT=========*/
UPDATE A
SET MONTH_END = 'Y'
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM A
JOIN (SELECT FULLDATE,DATESK, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY LASTDAYOFMONTH ORDER BY DATESK DESC) RN FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE YEAR = '2025' AND BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' ) B
    ON A.DATESK = B.DATESK AND B.RN = 1
WHERE YEAR = '2025';

/*=========VALIDATION=========*/--results should be 12 records
SELECT DATESK,FULLDATE,MONTH_END,Business_Day_Flag FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE YEAR = '2025' and month_end = 'Y'

SELECT A.DATESK,A.FULLDATE,A.BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,A.MONTH_END,A.YYYYMM
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM A
JOIN (SELECT FULLDATE,DATESK,YYYYMM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY YYYYMM ORDER BY DATESK DESC) RN FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE YEAR BETWEEN '2025' AND '2027' AND BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' ) B
    ON A.DATESK = B.DATESK AND B.RN = 1 AND A.YYYYMM = B.YYYYMM
WHERE YEAR BETWEEN '2025' AND '2027'
ORDER BY DATESK
